name: ai-char-engine
description: Conversational evidence-grounded persistent character engine with capability-aware Codex and local ComfyUI image orchestration.

interface.shortDescription: One character, intelligently shared across image engines.
interface.longDescription: A conversational Codex workflow that builds an evidence-grounded Character Brain and provider-neutral trusted reference fabric, can create a first identity with Codex or an optional validated local ComfyUI bootstrap workflow, intelligently routes later images, and permits bounded cross-provider reference expansion or repair without sacrificing lineage, privacy, or identity consistency.
defaultPrompt: Help me create a new persistent character from scratch and choose the best image engine intelligently.
I already have a character. Guide me through adding reference photos and make them usable by every supported image engine.
Generate a new photo of my saved character and choose or combine the image engines intelligently when useful.
Set up local ComfyUI image generation, including local character creation if I ask for it.
Set up the local adult model so explicit images of my adult character stay on my machine.
Update this repository to the latest AI Character Engine plugin and register it for Codex automatically.
